ruleSummary: 100% refund with deduction of no more than ₹1,500 as processing fee if withdrawn 15+ days before last date of admission.
90% refund if formally withdrawn less than 15 days before the formally notified last date of admission.
80% refund if formally withdrawn 15 days or less after the formally notified last date of admission.
50% refund if formally withdrawn between 16 and 30 days after the formally notified last date of admission.
0% refund (caution deposit only) if withdrawn more than 30 days after the formally notified last date of admission.
